blocks.name: customer_activity_and_spending
blocks.sql: SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, COUNT(r.review_time) AS reviews_all, COALESCE(SUM(p.price), 0.0) AS spending_all, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS reviews_30d, COALESCE(SUM(p.price) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'), 0.0) AS spending_30d, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '91 days') AS reviews_91d, COALESCE(SUM(p.price) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '91 days'), 0.0) AS spending_91d, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days') AS reviews_365d, COALESCE(SUM(p.price) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'), 0.0) AS spending_365d, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(r.review_time), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_review, DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(r.review_time), e.timestamp) AS days_since_first_review, (EPOCH(MAX(r.review_time)) - EPOCH(MIN(r.review_time))) / 86400.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(r.review_time) - 1, 0) AS mean_gap_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN review r ON r.customer_id = e.customer_id AND r.review_time < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp

blocks.name: customer_matured_outcomes
blocks.sql: SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, ARG_MAX(m.ltv, m.timestamp) AS last_matured_ltv, AVG(m.ltv) AS mean_matured_ltv, COUNT(m.label_window_end) AS matured_label_count FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN matured_labels m ON m.customer_id = e.customer_id AND m.timestamp < e.timestamp AND m.label_window_end < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp

objects.name: customer_spending_periods
objects.sql: WITH periods(end_age_days, start_age_days) AS (VALUES (0, 91), (91, 182), (182, 273), (273, 365)) SELECT e.customer_id, e.timestamp, w.end_age_days AS period_end_age_days, COUNT(r.review_time) AS review_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.price), 0.0) AS spending, AVG(p.price) AS mean_product_price, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(r.review_time AS DATE)) AS active_review_days FROM eval_table e CROSS JOIN periods w JOIN review r ON r.customer_id = e.customer_id AND r.review_time < e.timestamp AND r.review_time >= e.timestamp - w.start_age_days * INTERVAL '1 day' AND r.review_time < e.timestamp - w.end_age_days * INTERVAL '1 day' LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY e.customer_id, e.timestamp, w.end_age_days
